fixes.explanation: Ooh, I see the thinking, baker, but rich never made it onto this list. Rich tried to sneak in like a raisin in the chocolate chip batch, and the list wasn't having it. Jesus ends His report with "…the good news is preached to the poor." That's the last thing He tells John's disciples to carry back, so the word that fits is poor.

That's right, baker. Jesus says, "And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come." He says it plainly. It comes with an "…if you are willing…" so He leaves it to the crowd to take it in.
